groups.name: N0n
groups.profile: Data-extortion leak site tracked by Ransomware.live since 2026-09-18. Posts detailed dataset inventories (record counts, PII fields) tagged “NOT PAID — EXPOSED”, often naming downstream client data; also runs masked “Company #NN” teasers. Today: two batches (01:22–01:24 and 10:51–10:54 UTC), including two Gulf fashion-retail loyalty databases of ~3M customers each.
groups.countries: United States, Italy, Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates

groups.name: Akira
groups.profile: RaaS active since March 2023, widely linked by researchers to ex-Conti talent. Known for abusing VPN/remote-access credentials and edge-device flaws, double extortion, and “we will upload Ngb” notices. Today: 160 GB claimed across two new listings; two further postings were data-release follow-ups on victims already covered (reposts, see footer).

groups.name: Genesis
groups.profile: Emerging double-extortion group first observed late 2025 (Ransomware.live tracking since 2025-10-21), focused on small and mid-sized US organisations and on data exfiltration and leaking. Posts terse one-line victim descriptions.

groups.name: SilentRansomGroup
groups.profile: Also known as Luna Moth / Chatty Spider / UNC3753; ex-Conti offshoot. Encryption-free data extortion via callback phishing and IT-support impersonation, heavily focused on US law firms. RansomLook: “leakeddata”.

groups.name: Dire Wolf
groups.profile: Human-operated ransomware first documented May 2025; Golang encryptor (Curve25519/ChaCha20), run by a tight core team rather than a broad affiliate programme; ransoms reported up to $500,000; manufacturing and technology focus across 13+ countries.

groups.name: Eclipse
groups.profile: Leak operation tracked by Ransomware.live since 2026-08-11; little public profiling so far. Posts long company profiles without proof material.

groups.name: INC Ransom
groups.profile: RaaS active since July 2023 and among the most prolific operations (200+ victims posted in 2025), with heavy healthcare, government and education targeting in North America and Europe.

groups.name: Interlock
groups.profile: Ransomware group first observed September 2024; double extortion against healthcare, government, education and technology in North America and Europe; claimed a major US dialysis provider.

groups.name: Qilin
groups.profile: Also known as Agenda; first observed July 2022. Golang/Rust RaaS, among the most prolific operations of 2025–26. Affiliates use valid accounts, phishing and public-facing exploits.

groups.name: Shiba
groups.profile: Leak operation tracked by Ransomware.live since 2026-07-27; little public profiling. Today’s post targets an Italian state school.
